entries.zh: 悬望，焦急地盼望；挂心等待
entries.en: to await anxiously; to be in suspense
entries.notes: L 作 esperar con ansia，H 仅单字「懸」，与 M 三音节不完全对应，取「懸望」义。

entries.en: to wait; to await; to stay
entries.notes: M 栏「haû : l. hoû」并记 haû、hoû 两读。

entries.en: to await (orders); to wait for
to attend upon; to wait on
entries.notes: H 作「伺侍」非常见词，M 首音节 tū 与「伺」常读不合，字形或音写其一有误。

entries.en: to wait for; to await (someone)
entries.notes: 「听待」为罕用词形，M 与 H 逐字对音一致，暂从字面。

entries.en: to attend upon; to stay in attendance
to wait on; to serve; to attend
to wait a moment; hold on
entries.notes: H 栏原字作「謾」而标 [疑:謾/慢]，M 音 bẫ 亦在两可之间，取「且慢」义。

entries.en: to wait a while; to pause for a time

entries.zh: 且宽几时，再宽限等候些时
entries.en: to wait a while longer; to grant a little more time
[Original damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: L 作 esperar Sto tiempo（Sto 疑为 esto/cierto 之省），H 字有疑，M 末二音节 pât sī 无对应汉字，材料不足。

entries.en: to tolerate; to bear with; to put up with
entries.notes: L 栏「esperara go necespario」讹脱，H 标 [疑:悉/息]，M 以省略号收尾；依「姑息」常用义出释。

entries.en: to look forward to; to gaze ahead in expectation
entries.notes: H 标 [疑:瞻/膽]，M chiam 合「瞻」；L「el go」疑有脱字。

entries.en: to look up to; to await with hope
to hope for; to await in confidence
entries.notes: H 标 [疑:翼/冀]，M gūy 对应「冀」之俗读，取「冀望」义。

entries.zh: 候缺，等候官职空缺补任
entries.en: to wait for a vacancy in office
entries.notes: L 栏缩写残损（el off. 应为 el oficio），H/M 明指候补官职，合 17 世纪马尼拉官场语境。

entries.en: to be patient; to bear with; to make allowance

entries.zh: 留人等候，使人干等；耽搁
entries.en: to keep someone waiting; to delay
entries.notes: H 第二字标 [疑:常/帶]，M hû 与二者均不密合；L「hazerle esperar」义明，据此出释。

entries.en: to wait until something is accomplished; to await the day of success

entries.zh: 待慢，慢慢地等；从容等候
entries.en: to wait slowly; to wait at leisure
entries.notes: L「esperar de espacio」即从容等候，H「待慢」若作常用词则为怠慢，两义并存，取与 L 相合者。

entries.en: to bide one's time; to wait for the right moment
